bookingUnitId.title: Booking Unit ID or Name
bookingUnitId.description: Optional related Booking Unit record ID or Booking Unit name. Pass the broker-provided booking reference here whether it is an ID or a name.

brokerContactId.title: Broker Contact ID
brokerContactId.description: Portal user contact id from session context

caseType.title: Case Type
caseType.description: Value for the backend Case Type field, API name Type. Must be exactly one of: Booking Issue, Payment Plan Issue, Comission Issue, Portal Access Issue, Lead Creation Issue, General, Document Issue, Other.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed description of the broker issue.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Priority value such as Low, Medium, or High.

relatedCommissionId.title: Related Commission ID or Name
relatedCommissionId.description: Optional related Commission record ID or Commission name. Pass the broker-provided name when they mention a commission by name.

relatedLeadId.title: Related Lead ID or Name
relatedLeadId.description: Optional related Lead record ID or Lead name. Pass the broker-provided name when they mention a lead by name.

relatedOpportunityId.title: Related Opportunity ID or Name
relatedOpportunityId.description: Optional related Opportunity record ID or Opportunity name. Pass the broker-provided name when they mention an opportunity by name.

relatedUnitId.title: Related Unit ID or Name
relatedUnitId.description: Optional related Unit record ID or Unit name. Pass the broker-provided name when they mention a unit by name.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Short subject of the broker support case.
